chapter: Maynard Ferguson and the drinking life
title: Returning from Korea and playing with Gap Mangione
summary: He gets his family home from Korea, then plays two years in Gap Mangione's trio with bassist Steve Davis.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Jeez, something to be said for adrenalin I guess.
Well I’ve got to jump ahead a little bit because we’re well into our second hour here. But your got your family home from Korea?

Yeah. I left the band in Japan and went to Korea and brought them back. And then Gap Mangione was in there someplace. I used to play with him. Oh yeah, I went with Jack Maheu and then I went with Gap Mangione’s trio for a couple of years, and we were playing on top of a bar. We did so many, he did two jobs a day. Steve Davis was the bass player who had been on John Coltrane’s “My Favorite Things.”
Right. Was that at the Top of the Plaza or something like that? In Rochester?
No, that’s where I played — the Top of the Plaza was across the street, that touring thing with Maynard Ferguson.
